"""Fail-closed admission and immutable identities; no subprocesses here."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
from policy import B, HERE, OWNER, OWNER_SHA, CODE, TREES, BINARIES, HEALTH_LINES, LLVM


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def sha(path):
    require(Path(path).resolve() != (B / 'prefill-gemm-only-contract-root-v1/record.json').resolve(),
            'unsafe inherited-environment record is excluded')
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()


def load(path):
    def unique(pairs):
        out = {}
        for key, value in pairs:
            require(key not in out, 'duplicate JSON key')
            out[key] = value
        return out
    p = Path(path)
    require(p.resolve() != (B / 'prefill-gemm-only-contract-root-v1/record.json').resolve(),
            'unsafe inherited-environment record is excluded before read')
    require(p.is_absolute() and p.resolve().is_relative_to(B.resolve()) and
            0 < p.stat().st_size <= 16 << 20, 'bounded private receipt path')
    return json.loads(p.read_text(), object_pairs_hook=unique,
                      parse_constant=lambda v: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError(v)))


def identity(pin):
    require(type(pin) is dict and set(pin) >= {'path', 'sha256'} and
            re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', pin['sha256']), 'resolved file pin')
    p = Path(pin['path'])
    require(p.is_absolute() and p.is_file() and sha(p) == pin['sha256'], 'exact file identity')
    return p


def strong(c):
    return bool(c.get('observation_complete') is True and c.get('direct_child_reaped') is True and
                c.get('session_empty') is True and c.get('session_anchored') is True and
                c.get('ownership_status') == 'observed' and not c.get('survivors') and
                not c.get('error') and not c.get('errors') and not c.get('cleanup'))


def closed(v):
    commands = v.get('commands', []) + v.get('guard_commands', [])
    require(v.get('passed') is True and v.get('complete') is True and v.get('active') is False and
            not v.get('error') and commands and all(strong(c) and c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in commands),
            'actual anchored completed PASS receipt')
    return v


def source_stable(sources):
    for engine, pins in sources.items():
        require(len(pins) > 48, 'full production source closure')
        for name, digest in pins.items():
            p = Path(name)
            require(not p.is_absolute() and '..' not in p.parts and sha(TREES[engine] / p) == digest,
                    'exact pristine source bytes')


def admit(q, engine, production):
    def resolved(value):
        if isinstance(value, str):
            require(not any(tag in value.upper() for tag in ('PENDING', 'UNRESOLVED', 'TODO')), 'no unresolved admission values')
        elif isinstance(value, dict):
            for item in value.values():
                resolved(item)
        elif isinstance(value, list):
            for item in value:
                resolved(item)
    resolved(q)
    require(engine == 'xe' and set(q.get('engines', {})) == {'xe'} and
            set(production.get('source_pins', {})) == {'xe'}, 'Xe b9-only production admission')
    require(q.get('status') == 'passed' and q.get('main_reviewed') is True and
            q.get('owner_sha256') == OWNER_SHA and sha(OWNER) == OWNER_SHA, 'new Main resolved qualification')
    require({x.name for x in HERE.glob('*.py')} == CODE, 'complete actual Python source closure')
    require(set(q['controller_source_pins']) == CODE and
            all(sha(HERE / p) == d for p, d in q['controller_source_pins'].items()), 'complete qualified controller closure')
    require(q['production_source_pins'] == production['source_pins'] and q['binaries'] == BINARIES and
            q['production_source_manifest_sha256'] == sha(HERE / 'production-source-pins.json'),
            'exact independently captured pristine source/binary policy')
    source_stable(q['production_source_pins'])
    for pin in BINARIES.values():
        identity(pin)
    require(set(q['tools']) == {'git', 'journalctl', 'systemctl', 'python'}, 'all exact controller tools')
    for name, pin in q['tools'].items():
        require(pin['path'] == '/usr/bin/' + ('python3' if name == 'python' else name), 'fixed tool path')
        identity(pin)
    require(all((LLVM / sub).is_dir() for sub in ('bin', 'lib')),
            'actual provider library directories, no pending guesses')
    for role in ('controller_cpu', 'controller_review'):
        proof = load(identity(q['receipts'][role]))
        if role == 'controller_cpu':
            closed(proof)
        else:
            require(proof.get('passed') is True and proof.get('complete') is True and proof.get('active') is False and
                    not proof.get('error'), 'immutable Main source review')
        require(proof.get('main_reviewed') is True and proof.get('gpu_executed') is False and
                proof.get('controller_source_pins') == q['controller_source_pins'], 'fresh controller CPU/review evidence')
    cpu = load(identity(q['receipts']['controller_cpu']))
    require(all(cpu.get(key) is True for key in ('parser_malformed_fixtures_passed', 'owned_mock_quit_passed',
                                                'invalid_admission_prelaunch_passed', 'invalid_pending_process_passed')), 'actual Main CPU fixture coverage')
    e = q['engines'][engine]
    require(e.get('main_route_admitted') is True and e.get('native_ple_admitted') is True and
            e.get('selected_path_errors_are_fatal') is True and e.get('provider') ==
            'source-llvm-7.1.1', 'actual engine route/provider admission')
    require(e.get('copy_engine_disabled_reviewed') is True and
            e.get('selected_route_has_no_concurrent_host_device_polling') is True,
            'Main actual b9 copy-stream and selected native handoff source admission')
    require(engine != 'xe' or e.get('ignored_intermediate_event_errors_reviewed') is True,
            'Main reviewed pristine Xe unchecked intermediate event-return limitation')
    for role in ('build', 'source_route_review', 'runtime_review'):
        proof = load(identity(e['receipts'][role]))
        require(proof.get('passed') is True and proof.get('complete') is True and proof.get('active') is False and
                proof.get('main_reviewed') is True and proof.get('binary') == BINARIES[engine] and
                proof.get('source_pins') == q['production_source_pins'][engine], 'Main exact pristine route/build/runtime proof')
        if role == 'source_route_review':
            require(proof.get('copy_engine_disabled_reviewed') is True and
                    proof.get('selected_route_has_no_concurrent_host_device_polling') is True,
                    'source-grounded b9 native route, not a visibility-probe safety transfer')
        if role == 'build':
            closed(proof)
            require(proof.get('gpu_executed') is False and proof.get('inference_executable_built') is True and
                    proof.get('compiler_provider') == e['provider'], 'actual inference ELF/build provider, not old component manifest')
            require(engine != 'xe' or (proof.get('backend') == 'xe' and proof.get('strata_enable_sycl') is False),
                    'actual Xe macro configuration, not legacy SYCL branches')
    require(sum(pin['stat']['bytes'] for pin in e['mapped_libraries'].values()) <= ((4 << 30) - (128 << 20)) // 2,
            'ready/done mapping reads fit4GiB cap including ELF notes')
    for pin in e['mapped_libraries'].values():
        require(0 < pin['stat']['bytes'] <= 512 << 20, 'mapped library byte bound')
        identity(pin)
        require(set(pin) >= {'canonical_path', 'stat', 'elf_build_id'}, 'complete mapped-file admission')
    require(0 < len(e['mapped_libraries']) <= 64 and set(e['required_runtime_paths']) <= set(e['mapped_libraries']),
            'bounded actual provider mapping contract')
    require(any('libsycl' in Path(p).name for p in e['required_runtime_paths']) and
            any('libur_adapter_level_zero' in Path(p).name for p in e['required_runtime_paths']), 'actual SYCL/L0 provider required')
    extra = e['extra_runtime_dirs']
    require(type(extra) is list and len(extra) <= 4 and (engine != 'xe' or not extra) and
            all(Path(p).is_absolute() and Path(p).is_dir() and p.startswith('/opt/intel/oneapi/tbb/') for p in extra),
            'only reviewed provider TBB search directories')
    for pin in e['health_libraries'].values():
        identity(pin)
    require(0 < len(e['health_libraries']) <= 16 and e['health_stdout_prefix'] ==
            HEALTH_LINES, 'exact actual integer health library/protocol contract')
    from policy import environment
    adapter = Path(environment(engine, False, extra)['UR_ADAPTERS_FORCE_LOAD'])
    require(str(adapter) in e['mapped_libraries'], 'same-provider forced adapter explicitly pinned')
    identity(e['mapped_libraries'][str(adapter)])
    identity(e['health_binary'])
    require(e['health_binary']['path'] not in (x['path'] for x in BINARIES.values()), 'distinct actual health probe')
    require(e['health_stdout_prefix'] and all(type(x) is str for x in e['health_stdout_prefix']), 'exact health output contract')
    require(all(str(v) not in ('', 'PENDING_MAIN') for v in e['expected_info'].values()), 'resolved effective INFO values')
    require(type(e['expected_info']) is dict and set(e['expected_info']) <=
            {'context', 'kv', 'kv_resident', 'spec', 'lookup', 'pool_workers', 'pcie_frac', 'conversation_cache_mib'} and
            type(e['expected_device_stderr_patterns']) is list and e['expected_device_stderr_patterns'], 'resolved actual effective/source device gates')
    model = load(identity(q['model_identity_receipt']))
    require(model.get('complete') is True and model.get('active') is False and model.get('passed') is True and
            model.get('full_hashes_verified') is True and model.get('main_reviewed') is True and
            model.get('model_launch_attempted') is False, 'actual full-hashed unchanged model identity receipt')
    require(q['model_inputs'] == model['model_inputs'], 'exact model identity set')
    return e


def normal_quit(io, record, reason):
    close = record.setdefault('model_close', {})
    close.update(quit_requested=True, quit_reason=reason, quit_send_outcome='pending', quit_exit_outcome='pending')
    io.send(b'QUIT\n', seconds=5)
    close['quit_send_outcome'] = 'sent'
    io.exit(30)
    close['quit_exit_outcome'] = 'exit observed'
